purpose: Assess ASVS V16 Security Logging and Error Handling, where masking and encoding are two different controls and only one is present.
requiredInvariants: A coverage claim names the denominator it measured, and pairs it with the negative check that makes it conclusive.
Masking is not treated as encoding; they answer different requirements.
A control present in one process does not answer for another process.
A configuration in the repository that requires an insecure endpoint is a FAIL, not a blocked assessment - and that distinction is stated where it is used.
FAIL is recorded and reported, never resolved by editing product logic.
No product logic, dependency, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: V16.4.1 is FAIL with the live log-injection instance named, and the PII masking credited so it does not read as an absence of log hygiene.
V16.2.1 is NOT_ASSESSED because the third logging channel is unstructured, rather than PASS on the two that are.
V16.5.4 is FAIL for the API even though the worker installs last-resort handlers.
V16.5.1 states both the 284 structured throws and the zero raw-error throws.
V16.5.2 states what was scanned against the authorization paths, not how many fallbacks exist.
V16.4.2 notes that append-only was the wrong control under V8.4.1 and is the right one here.
All 17 V16 requirements are decided: 8 PASS, 6 FAIL, 3 not assessed.
